{{Infobox weapon |description = A slight risk of frostbite is inevitable. |type = fists |id = FistGold_FrostFire | source = [[Black Forge]] | durability = 400 | crafting level = 4 | repair level = | blunt = 80 | slash per level = 8 | fire = 12 | fire per level = 3 | frost = 88 | frost per level = 3 | knockback = 20 |materials 1= * [[Bloodgold]] x20 * [[Nord Knucklechains]] x1 * [[Frostfire Essence]] x1 |materials 2= * [[Bloodgold]] x10 * [[Frostfire Essence]] x1 |materials 3= * [[Bloodgold]] x20 * [[Frostfire Essence]] x2 |materials 4= * [[Bloodgold]] x40 * [[Frostfire Essence]] x4 | stamina = 14 | stamina secondary = 20 | block armor = | movement speed = | weight=2.0 | special = }} '''Frostfire Knucklechains''' are a version of [[Nord Knucklechains]] upgraded with [[Frostfire Essence]]. Upgraded Nord Knucklechains will '''NOT''' keep their upgrade level when they are modified using essences. The primary attack is a 2-hit combo with 2x damage at the second hit.
